title: Improve error handling - reduce silent failures
description:
## Problem
Multiple `.catch()` handlers silently ignore errors, making it unclear if operations actually succeeded:

```typescript
.catch(this.warnOnFail('/api/channels/groups/', [], jobId));
```

This logs warnings but doesn't fail the job, leading to partial imports that appear successful.

## Files Affected
- `backend/src/services/importService.ts` (lines 151, 490, 528, etc.)
- `backend/src/services/exportService.ts` (various locations)

## Solution
1. Track partial failures in job results
2. Add `warnings` array to job result
3. Mark job as 'completed_with_warnings' status when partial failures occur
4. Show warnings prominently in UI

```typescript
interface JobResult {
  status: 'completed' | 'completed_with_warnings' | 'failed';
  warnings: string[];
  errors: string[];
}
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Add 'completed_with_warnings' job status
- [ ] Track warnings separately from errors
- [ ] Update job results to include warnings array
- [ ] Update frontend to show warnings prominently
- [ ] Add tests for partial failure scenarios

title: Refactor sync to use internal export/import
description:
Sync has consistently had issues with pagination, logo assignment, and feature parity with backup/restore. Refactor sync to internally perform an export from source and import to destination, ensuring guaranteed parity.

## Problem
- Sync has separate implementations for each data type that keep drifting from backup/restore
- Multiple pagination bugs found (logos only fetching first 50 items)
- Logo assignment to channels not working properly
- Constant maintenance burden keeping sync in parity with backup/restore

## Solution
Refactor sync to:
1. Export from source instance to a temp file
2. Import from that temp file to destination instance
3. Clean up temp file

This ensures sync always has feature parity with backup/restore since it uses the exact same code paths.

## Implementation Plan

### Phase 1: Refactor Sync Service
- [ ] In `sync()` method, replace all individual sync methods with:
  1. Authenticate to source and destination
  2. Call `exportService.export(source, options)` to create temp backup file
  3. Read the backup file into memory
  4. Call `importService.import(destination, backupData, options)` to restore to destination
  5. Clean up temp backup file
- [ ] Maintain progress reporting (export ~50%, import ~50%)
- [ ] Keep dry-run support (just run export, skip import)
- [ ] Handle errors and cleanup temp files on failure

### Phase 2: Testing & Cleanup
- [ ] Test sync with all options enabled
- [ ] Verify logo sync works correctly (all logos, with channel assignment)
- [ ] Verify channel groups, profiles, EPG, M3U sources all sync correctly
- [ ] Remove dead sync methods from syncService.ts (~1500+ lines)
- [ ] Update any tests that mock sync internals

## Benefits
- Single source of truth for export/import logic
- Automatic feature parity - any fix to backup/restore automatically applies to sync
- Reduced codebase size (remove ~1500+ lines of duplicated sync logic)
- Easier maintenance going forward
- Simple implementation - just use existing export/import with temp files

description: Redaction logic is duplicated in dispatcharrClient.ts and importService.ts. Extract to utils/redactionUtils.ts.

title: Add rate limiting for API calls to Dispatcharr
description: The code makes many sequential API calls without rate limiting. Could cause issues if the target Dispatcharr server has strict rate limits. No exponential backoff on failures. Consider adding configurable rate limiting and retry logic with exponential backoff.

title: Break down large import/export functions
description: import() and export() functions are 500-600 lines. Extract logo, M3U, EPG handling to smaller methods.

title: Split large frontend components
description: Notifications, Connections, Import are 900+ lines each.

title: Add backup file encryption at rest
description: Roadmap feature: Encrypt backup files at rest for security. Important for users storing backups on shared or cloud storage.

title: Extract duplicate upload progress handler
description: api.ts has identical handler repeated 3 times.

title: console.error misused for debug/info logging
description: In routes/import.ts lines 22, 35, 37, console.error() is being used for info/debug messages like '[INSPECT ROUTE] Received file'. These should use console.log or proper info-level logging instead, as they're not actual errors.

title: Extract hardcoded magic numbers to constants
description: Many hardcoded timeouts and intervals throughout the codebase should be extracted to a constants file: dispatcharrClient.ts:17 (120000ms HTTP timeout), info.ts:70 (5000ms GitHub timeout), importService.ts:1719 (3000ms delay), Jobs.svelte:30 (3000ms poll), Schedules.svelte:377 (10000ms poll), exportService.ts:482 (15000ms logo timeout). Create backend/src/constants.ts and frontend/src/constants.ts.

title: Extract duplicated redaction logic to shared utility
description: Redaction logic is duplicated in dispatcharrClient.ts and importService.ts. Extract to utils/redactionUtils.ts.

title: Make setTimeout calls cancellable during job cancellation
description: Multiple setTimeout calls (10+) in importService.ts continue running after job cancellation. Add cancellableDelay() method that polls for cancellation.

title: Temp files accumulate without cleanup
Missing cancellation token support in long-running operations
description: Long-running loops in syncService.ts (waitForEpgData, waitForStreams) and importService.ts don't consistently check for job cancellation. If a job is cancelled during channel import (~line 1111), the operation continues processing. Add throwIfCancelled() checks in all loops to respect user cancellation requests.

title: Split large frontend components (Notifications, Connections, Import)
description: Notifications.svelte (987 lines), Connections.svelte (983 lines), Import.svelte (922 lines) should be split into smaller components.

title: Add external storage export support (S3, SMB, NAS)
description: Roadmap feature: Allow backup export to external storage like S3, SMB shares, or NAS. Currently users need local storage for backups. Would enable cloud backup strategies.

title: Missing path traversal protection in ZIP extraction
description: In importService.ts:506-518, there's no validation that extracted file paths stay within the base directory. A malicious ZIP could contain entries like '../../../etc/passwd' that would traverse outside the intended directory. Need to validate that fullPath stays within baseDir after path.join().

title: Silent error swallowing in API catch blocks
description: Multiple locations use .catch(() => []) which silently swallows errors without logging. This makes debugging very difficult when API calls fail. Examples: importService.ts:332-944, syncService.ts:46-50. Errors should be logged to jobManager before returning empty arrays.

title: Consolidate duplicate logo processing code
Enable TypeScript strict mode incrementally
description: tsconfig.json has strict: false and noImplicitAny disabled. Allows unsafe type coercion throughout codebase. Enable strict mode and fix type errors incrementally for better type safety.

title: Establish unit test suite with Jest/Vitest
description: Currently only basic smoke test exists. Need unit tests for core services: exportService, importService, syncService, jobManager. Target 70%+ coverage for critical paths.

title: Debug console.log statements in frontend production code
description: Debug logs left in production code: App.svelte:13 'console.log(App component init)', main.ts:26 'console.log(Mounting App...)', Import.svelte:112-113 'console.error([FRONTEND] Received sections...)'. These should be removed or wrapped in development-only conditionals.
